user_summary.hu: Kis oldalt tesz a netre, amit csak az lát, akinek megengeded
user_summary.en: Puts a small page online that only the people you allow can see

summary.hu: Kis webes felület a netre: Worker + D1 a workers.dev címen, Access-védelemmel
summary.en: A small web page online: Worker + D1 on workers.dev, behind Access

entry: follow the publish-web steps; go live only with: python3 .mentat/bin/mentat_web.py deploy --approved "<the USER's yes>" --url <address> -- npx wrangler deploy
enable_steps: the steps in the docs, in order
limits: no tunnel, no VPN from the machine, no own password: Access protects it
deploy only on the USER's explicit yes
extends: the Worker's own routes; the check is web.check

summary.hu: Él-e az oldal úgy, ahogy a FELHASZNÁLÓ látja (bejelentkezve)
summary.en: Is the page up the way the USER sees it (signed in)

limits: one request, no redirect followed: a sign-in redirect is not up

summary.hu: Helyi oldal, űrlap vagy fejlesztői szerver, ami nem akasztja meg a fordulót; titok bekérése rejtett mezővel
summary.en: A local page, form or dev server that never blocks the turn; a secret asked with a hidden field

entry: python3 .mentat/bin/mentat_serve.py start NAME --dir FOLDER | --secret VAR [--env .env] | [--port P] -- <command>   (status; stop NAME); a key already in the chat: python3 .mentat/bin/mentat_secret.py put VAR (stdin); is it set: mentat_secret.py has VAR
limits: 127.0.0.1 only: on a server the USER's own device cannot open it

summary.hu: Élesítés csak a FELHASZNÁLÓ igenjével, utána ellenőrzés
summary.en: Go live only on the USER's yes, then check

entry: python3 .mentat/bin/mentat_web.py deploy --approved "<the USER's yes, verbatim>" [--url URL] -- <deploy command>

summary.hu: Cloudflare API-token lépésenként, minden lépés után ellenőrizve
summary.en: The Cloudflare API token step by step, checked after each step

entry: python3 .mentat/bin/web/mentat_cf_token.py next   (--check: valid and every permission)
enable_steps: python3 .mentat/bin/web/mentat_cf_token.py next (one STEP to the USER at a time)
limits: the probe sees only that the key is set, not that it is valid: run --check

summary.hu: Csak a megadott e-mailek láthatják: Cloudflare Access API-n
summary.en: Only the given e-mails can see it: Cloudflare Access via the API

entry: python3 .mentat/bin/web/mentat_cf_access.py ensure --worker NAME --email E [--email E2]   (check --worker NAME)
limits: the Worker gets no password of its own: Access is the protection
